name: Royal Castle Grounds
description: Home. The castle halls and the training yards, where the sisters learn to fight side by side.
mechanics: Short routes and training fights. The Castle Depths open once the sisters have walked their own halls.

contracts.note: Contracts (scripts/progression/contracts.gd): offered once every mission above is completed. base_level = party level for rank 1 (+1 per rank, max 10); enemies gain hp_per_tier / damage_per_tier per rank.

name: Crystal Cave
description: Caves beneath the castle cliffs, glittering with living crystal. Crystal beasts gather around the Crystal Wyrm.
mechanics: A short cave route through the chasm, the grotto and old ruins, with a merchant camp and the Crystal Wyrm at its end.

contracts.note: Contracts (scripts/progression/contracts.gd): offered once every mission above is completed. base_level = party level for rank 1 (+1 per rank, max 10); enemies gain hp_per_tier / damage_per_tier per rank.

name: Enchanted Forest
description: An old forest of mossy giants, river falls and mountain trails, poisoned at its heart by the Forest Serpent.
mechanics: Three trails: mountain wolves, the deepwood's spiders and beasts, and the river falls. Villages offer rest and trade.

contracts.note: Contracts (scripts/progression/contracts.gd): offered once every mission above is completed. base_level = party level for rank 1 (+1 per rank, max 10); enemies gain hp_per_tier / damage_per_tier per rank.

name: Sunlit Coast
description: Golden dunes, sea caves and a storm that never sleeps. Pirates and sea beasts haunt the shore and the open water.
mechanics: Fights on the beach and aboard the ship at sea. Sandstorms blind, waves soak.

contracts.note: Contracts (scripts/progression/contracts.gd): offered once every mission above is completed. base_level = party level for rank 1 (+1 per rank, max 10); enemies gain hp_per_tier / damage_per_tier per rank.

name: Frostpeak
description: A mountain climb through pine slopes, glacier caves and the summit above the clouds, where the White Dragon nests.
mechanics: The higher the climb, the colder the foes: Frostbitten makes frost wounds deeper. Only a few foes fear fire.
